description: Get current EV/Revenue, EV/EBIT, EV/EBITDA, trailing and forward P/E, Price/Sales and Price/Book with peer median, quartiles and sample size; REITs add company-stated P/FFO and P/AFFO, and a verified reconciliation adds EV over Adjusted EBITDA. TTM flows use four discrete quarters or an exact annual-plus-YTD bridge, never an annual alone. P/E uses validated diluted EPS or income available to common, basis named. EV/EBITDA adds TTM D&A to TTM operating income. Forward P/E uses consensus EPS, possibly adjusted, for the next fiscal year. EV uses same-date reported debt, cash and short-term investments. Inputs reconcile, share one split basis and are USD; nothing is estimated. Peers exclude the company, size-banded within the industry. A MIC:TICKER of a company no US exchange lists is priced on its own cap and reports: P/E, Price/Sales and Price/Book, each on TTM or its newest fiscal year as labelled, without EV or peers. Use GetValuationMultiplesHistory for history.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:MC) for a listing outside the US.
